public.title: Longest Common Prefix
public.description: Return the longest prefix shared by every word. An empty array has prefix "". There are 0 to 200 lowercase English strings, each of length 0 to 200, with at most 10000 characters in total. Prefix matching is exact.
hints: Begin with the first word as a candidate.
Shorten the candidate until each word starts with it.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: The candidate only shrinks, eventually becoming the longest prefix common to all processed words. For n words of maximum length L, O(n*L + L²) worst-case time and O(L) working space.
